referenceDelta.scope: Full wire/wire and wire/via planar widths against all exported islands physically labeled GND minus span-qualified Excellon and NPTH holes. Only real own component terminal .36mm aperture masks; direct surface SMT footprint masked on its own routing surface only. No midpoint or foreign-hole masks. Spatial comparison allows2um exported-coordinate tolerance for previously uncovered polygons, not a clearance waiver. No SI/fabrication qualification.

centerlineAudit.method: Native nonzero XY centerline multiset including wire/via joins; before-body segments must survive in the same named after-body. Sum after-body plus newly added pad traces; inherited pad traces are excluded from both lengths. No electrical-delay or length-match qualification.

limitations: placement preserves the original three-check subset for historical comparison; fullPlacement contains the complete upstream placement suite without suppression.
Supplemental geometry metrics only; run cloud-trace-lint.ts separately for the official trace-style analyzer.
Curved routes are sampled; small successive turns do not establish deliberate path quality. Inspect enlarged native layer images.
Lengths are planar geometry, not electrical timing or impedance checks.
